column1: # Probes for the Book of Verse cases not tagged verse_vm_only that OpenVerse refuses where the tests expect a valid program (#724): one form per probe, the Book's cases in book_case, the lines each prints if Epic admits it (the form working as the Book says) in book_lines, what OpenVerse does in each probe's header and in note (Lean and C agreeing, at ce8632ea); Epic's outcome in epic_outcome and epic_lines (UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086; - where not yet compiled). The question each asks: does Epic's shipped compiler admit it? Compile each alone first (single mode); run the admitted ones on the Verse VM.
